parts.text:
An electrochemical cell is set up to measure $E^\ominus$ of the $\text{Ag}^+\text{(aq)}/\text{Ag(s)}$ electrode.

Draw a labelled diagram of this electrochemical cell.

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text:

Suggest how the electrode potential, $E$, for the $\text{Ag}^+\text{(aq)}/\text{Ag(s)}$ electrode would change from its $E^\ominus$ value.

Explain your answer.
